summary: Daily Closing Report flow + auto-revenue side-effect tested end-to-end. 18/18 backend tests pass and re-pass on repeated runs (idempotent). Verified: (a) POST /payments/collect auto-creates pending revenue financial_transaction with reference_id=payment.id, reference_type='payment', amount, status='pending'; (b) /closing-reports/preview structure; (c) collector submit + duplicate-day 400 + role gating (BM=403, unauth=401/403); (d) BA branch-rollup with empty/unknown ids => 400, non-BA => 403; (e) AM validate cascades to children AND flips linked pending revenue FTx to validated; (f) AM reject does NOT flip linked FTx; (g) GET /closing-reports filter + FC-scoping; (h) GET /payments/history-by-client shape with 60-day SOA + totals/progress.

minor.issue: When re-collecting an existing (loan_id, day) pair, the payment doc is fully $set including a NEW uuid in 'id'. This orphans the previous auto-revenue FTx (its reference_id no longer matches the current payment doc). Also creates a second auto-revenue FTx pointing to the new id. Consider $set-excluding the id field, or skip auto-revenue post on update.

Duplicate-detect blocks resubmission only when existing status is in {pending, submitted, validated}. A 'rejected' collector close from the same day is silently allowed to be re-submitted (new pending) - intentional? Worth documenting.
Endpoint accepts any branch report id but does not 404 on a 'collector' report -- returns 400 'Only branch rollup can be validated'. Behavior is correct but client may want a clearer 422.
Allows multiple branch rollups per (BA, date) since there's no uniqueness check at the branch level. If BA accidentally submits two rollups including different collector subsets, both succeed.
Hard-coded to_list(2000) cap. With heavy data, recent FTx may overflow. Consider explicit ?limit / pagination.

action_items: Optional: prevent payment-doc id rotation on re-collect (preserve existing 'id' and only $set mutable fields) to avoid orphan FTx.
Optional: document/enforce uniqueness for branch rollups per (BA, date).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1136 lines (was 895). The 700-line threshold is well exceeded -- split into routers (payments, closing_reports, financial, users, loans).

_payments_for_date_user filters by 'action_at' regex ^YYYY-MM-DD; payment.action_at uses UTC isoformat, but preview default target_date uses UTC date too -- consistent. However if a tester passes a local-date string, late-evening payments could be missed at TZ rollover.
/payments/collect's auto-revenue posting is wrapped in try/except that only warns; failure silently leaves the payment without a revenue tx. Consider a retry or compensating mechanism.

validate_closing only flips FTx whose reference_id is in report.payment_ids AND status='pending'. If a previously-rejected branch's FTx were manually flipped, no recourse here -- acceptable but worth noting.
history-by-client iterates ALL payments (limit 20000) into memory then matches. For multi-branch scale, switch to per-loan aggregation pipeline.
test_credentials: All from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (admin, FC, BA, BM, V, AM, RO). All login OK.
seed_data_creation: Each run: creates 1 fresh loan tagged 'CRTEST_<hex>' via FC->BA->BM->V->AM->Admin->RO release; performs ~5 /payments/collect (days 1,2,4,6,30) + 1 /payments/pass (day 3); auto-creates ~5 pending revenue financial_transactions; creates 1 FC collector closing report + 1 admin collector closing report (E2E); creates 2 branch rollups (1 validated, 1 rejected). No teardown -- identifiable via CRTEST_ prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 5 backend test suites total now: test_efcis_backend, test_payments_backend, test_users_attendance_backend, test_financial_backend, test_closing_reports_backend. Closing report flow re-runs cleanly on same DB (admin-as-collector pattern used for E2E + reject to avoid FC state collisions). Heads-up: /payments/collect rotates the payment doc id on re-collect, so cumulative pending FTx will grow across runs -- filter by recent reference_id when asserting. /financial/transactions list is capped at 2000.
rca of the issue: Initial run had 1 failed assertion in E2E ('Expected linked FTx rows to exist pre-validation'). Root cause: relying on FC's collector_report.payment_ids snapshot across test classes was racy because (a) the snapshot included a 'pass' payment id that never produces a revenue FTx and (b) on subsequent runs FC's cr could already be in submitted/validated state from prior iterations, making pre-check empty. Fix: rewrote E2E to use admin-as-collector with a unique day (30) so each run can isolate the new payment_id and assert exact FTx flip. Added a parallel rejected-flow test (admin collector + BA rollup + AM reject) that asserts the targeted FTx remains pending. Re-run verified all 18 tests pass twice in a row.
